distinct_from.CYBERSECURITY: CYBERSECURITY (Harbor SOC Foundations) is the broad security foundation: governance, identity lifecycle, hardening, segmentation, the incident clock, and a forensic timeline. CYBER_SOC is the tier-1 analyst desk and its arithmetic: auth-log parsing, windowed rules, precision and recall, indicator hygiene, ATT&CK IDs, DMARC alignment, CVSS v3.1 scoring, triage order, and MTTD/MTTR.

claim_boundary: Synthetic logs and documentation IP ranges only; defensive practice, no live targets, no actor attribution. Not a SOC certification. Not student/teacher E6.
